events.title: Monthly Social - My Goodness
events.summary: Meeting new people can feel like a big step, so this event is focused on making making it as easy and accessible as possible for new and reconnecting members! Join us for our monthly social event - this month, this will be the at My Goodness Cafe (Co-op) The plan: We'll meet at…

events.title: Indoor Climbing at Awesome Walls
events.summary: Join us for some indoor climbing in Awesome Walls! Shoes available for rent at the climbing centre. 🧗 Please note: You will need to complete the Bouldering Induction. Online booking only available 48 hours in advance, after that you’ll need to call 0214867060 to book a slot…
